answer_1.quote: LLMs have impressive capabilities on a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and the generation of coherent text and code.

answer_2.quote: we report the percentage of the number of correct function assignments... we compute precision and recall of the arguments' names... BLEU metric... SciBERTscore... normalized Levenshtein distance

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4 as an evaluator, where given (i) a protocol description, (ii) admissible pseudofunctions, (iii) ground-truth pseudocode, and (iv) predicted pseudocode, the model is prompted to predict which one of (iii) or (iv) better matches the protocol description (i).

answer_4.quote: We worked with an undergraduate biomedical sciences student and asked them to complete the next step prediction task and the function selection task.
answer_4.guideline: The student had access to internet search and an unlimited amount of time to answer questions. With the next step prediction task we provided shuffled functions, and with the function selection task, we used random distractor functions.
